name: calcom_reschedule_booking
description: Reschedule a booking by its `uid` to a new `start` time (UTC ISO-8601 — use calcom_get_available_slots to pick an open one). Optional `reschedulingReason`. Updates the synced calendar event and notifies attendees.

uid.description: The booking's unique id (uid) to reschedule.

start.description: New start time, UTC ISO-8601 (an open slot).

reschedulingReason.description: Why the booking is being moved (shown to attendees) (optional).
